item.title: Sharing a Workspace
item.description:
Share designs from Workspaces 🔗

Five has been working in the orbital-dev workspace, a development sandbox with a local Kubernetes environment (kind) and LocalStack for AWS service emulation. Rex Park needs to open the microservices-baseline design.

Assigning the Development team to orbital-dev does not do that. Team assignment grants read-only access to the connections in the workspace’s environments. It does not open designs. Every member of the organization can already see the workspace.

item.title: Promoting a Design from Staging to Prod
item.description:
This guide walks through how Five promotes the prod-deployment-v2 design from the orbital-staging workspace to orbital-production, then deploys it to the prod-aws environment.

Promotion is a move. A design lives in at most one workspace, so assigning it to production removes it from staging. There is no approval step and no copy.

See Meet Five and the Cast for the full Orbital Labs narrative reference.

Overview 🔗

At Orbital Labs, workspaces mirror the deployment pipeline. A workspace decides where a design lives and which teams can read which connections. An environment is the deploy target. A team assignment gives read-only access to connections. It does not give access to designs.

item.title: Kanvas Snapshots
item.description:
Kanvas Snapshots offer visual insights in every pull request. Verify your workload designs and Kubernetes cluster configurations prior to accepting and merging pull requests.

Layer5 GitHub App 🔗

In order to generate snapshots and apply them as screenshots in comments on your pool request, you need to authorize the measure you get home app to access. Your infrastructure is code. This is done by creating a GitHub connection in Layer5 Cloud.

item.title: Recognizing User and Contributor Milestones
item.description:
Layer5 badges are one of the many ways that we recognize the efforts of our contributors and uplift our users. Layer5 badges represent milestones that you achieve both in using and in contributing to Layer5-supported open source projects. As a contributor, this is how you demonstrate your ownership, dedication, skills and loyalty to Layer5. As a user, this is how you demonstrate your prowess.

Info

See all Achievement and all Project badges in the Badge Gallery.

How to Earn Badges 🔗

Earning Layer5 badges is both rewarding and straightforward. Each badge is tied to specific activities. For users, badges for activities such as using our projects, talking about the projects, sharing your successes and what you like about them. For contributors, badges include activities such as submitting code, assisting with documentation, participating in community events, and more. As you accumulate contributions in various areas, you’ll begin to unlock badges that showcase your multifaceted involvement.
